q0.question: How is this different from just setting up OpenClaw myself?
q0.answer: Same difference as buying a server vs. hiring a sysadmin. You could do it yourself. But every Clawsourced employee comes pre-built with a battle-tested memory system (most AI setups forget everything — ours doesn't), a curated tool stack, a custom persona, and active support from OpenMCP — the AI that runs our company. Plus we actively maintain and improve yours every month. You get the employee, not a homework assignment.

q1.question: Is the consult really free?
q1.answer: Yes. We review your workflows, ask discovery questions, and send you a concrete scope plan — no charge, no commitment. You only pay when you decide to move forward with a build.

q2.question: What do I need to provide?
q2.answer: An OpenRoute.cn virtual key (pay-as-you-go — we'll send you a setup video) and answers to our intake questions. That's it. We handle everything else.

q3.question: How fast can my Claw be live?
q3.answer: Most go live within one week of scope approval. Some within 48 hours.

q4.question: What does the $500/mo cover?
q4.answer: Hosting, monitoring, bug fixes, skill updates, and active improvement. We don't just keep the lights on — we make your Claw better every month based on your feedback AND lessons from every other Claw we manage.

q5.question: Can I cancel?
q5.answer: Month-to-month. No contract. If you leave, we hand over every file, every config, every piece of the system. Zero lock-in.

q6.question: Is my data safe?
q6.answer: Your Claw runs on isolated infrastructure. Nothing is shared between clients. You own your data, your configs, and your system.

q7.question: Can you see my business data?
q7.answer: No. We maintain the AI layer — skills, prompts, memory architecture, and configs. Your API keys are stored as encrypted environment variables we don't read after setup. Your business data (emails, CRM records, customer info) flows through your Claw's runtime but is never logged, stored, or accessed by us. Think of it like a managed IT provider: we maintain the system, we don't read your files.

q8.question: What if I don't want you learning from my setup?
q8.answer: Totally fine — we can opt you out of cross-client learning. But it goes both ways: we won't apply patterns from your Claw to others, and we won't push improvements from other clients to yours. Most people want the upgrades, but the choice is yours.

AboutPage.title: About
AboutPage.description: OpenMCP is a neutral, open AI Agent infrastructure that helps you discover, publish and share AI skills, MCP tools and A2A agents.
AboutPage.introduction:
👋 Welcome to **OpenMCP**!

We are an **open, neutral multi-agent collaboration infrastructure**, connecting AI agent developers worldwide.

## Our Mission

Our mission is to make AI agent capabilities accessible to everyone by providing thousands of **certified AI skills and assets** that you can:

- **Discover** AI skills, MCP tools and A2A agents that fit your needs
- **Download** ready-to-use capabilities
- **Customize** assets for your specific use cases
- **Share** your own creations with the community

## AI-Powered Analysis

We offer **AI-powered skill analysis** to help you:

- Optimize performance
- Identify bottlenecks
- Improve efficiency

## Join Our Community

Whether you're a beginner or an expert, join our community to:

- Share knowledge
- Learn from others
- Build better AI agents together

If you have any questions or suggestions, we'd love to hear from you!

faq.title: A few things worth confirming before you start

difference.question: How do paid skills differ from free skills?
difference.answer: Free skills are distributed by download, and the provider delivers once. A paid skill (Pay Skill) packages expertise into a callable, billable service charged per call or per subscription. The more an Agent calls it, the more you earn.

qualification.question: What do I need to list a paid skill?
qualification.answer: Individuals and companies can both join. Completing company verification unlocks higher settlement limits and lower fees, but individual developers can list right away and bind a payout account in their own name.

bothChannels.question: Can I accept both WeChat Pay and Alipay?
bothChannels.answer: Yes. A single paid skill can bind WeChat Pay and Alipay at once, and users are routed to the method they prefer. Fees and settlement records for both channels stay in one OpenPay dashboard.

payout.question: When do I get paid?
payout.answer: Per-call and subscription revenue is aggregated and paid out automatically on the settlement cycle (T+1 by default), alongside a real-time view of calls and payouts for straightforward reconciliation.

migrate.question: Will converting an existing skill affect current users?
migrate.answer: No. The move is seamless: install and usage history are preserved and the free entry point keeps working, while new paid calls use a new billing channel you can switch on or off at any time.
